Complete Exit Survey

TCH LRN 415

A student may be admitted to the English – Teaching Option with Certification upon making their intention known to the department.

Requirements in this degree include 18 credits of core English Teaching courses and 18 credits of approved electives. 

An additional 40 credits of Teaching and Learning and Educational Psychology credits are required for certification.
